tools.name: change_sonar_issue_status
tools.title: Change SonarQube Issue Status
tools.description:
Change the status of an issue. This tool can be used to change the status of an issue to "accept", "falsepositive" or to "reopen" an issue.
An example request could be: I would like to accept the issue having the key "AX-HMISMFixnZED"

key.description: The key of the issue which status should be changed

status.description: The new status of the issue

issueKey.description: The key of the issue that was updated

newStatus.description: The new status of the issue

tools.name: search_my_sonarqube_projects
tools.title: Search My SonarQube Projects
tools.description: Find SonarQube projects in your organization. Supports searching by project name or key. Use this first when projectKey is unknown - most other tools require the project key from this response.

tools.name: change_security_hotspot_status
tools.title: Change SonarQube Security Hotspot Status
tools.description:
Change the status of a Security Hotspot to review it. When marking as REVIEWED, you must specify a resolution.
- TO_REVIEW: Mark the Security Hotspot as needing review
- REVIEWED: Mark the Security Hotspot as reviewed with one of these resolutions:
  * FIXED: A fix has been implemented
  * SAFE: Reviewed and determined to be safe
  * ACKNOWLEDGED: Acknowledged as a risk but accepted
You can optionally add a comment to explain your review decision.

hotspotKey.description: The key of the Security Hotspot to update

comment.description: An optional comment explaining the review decision

resolution.description: The resolution when status is REVIEWED. Required if status is REVIEWED

status.description: The new status of the Security Hotspot

hotspotKey.description: The key of the Security Hotspot that was updated

newResolution.description: The new resolution of the Security Hotspot (if status is REVIEWED)

newStatus.description: The new status of the Security Hotspot

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.title: List SonarQube Pull Requests
tools.description: List all pull requests for a project. Use this tool to discover available pull requests and their corresponding branch names before analyzing their coverage, issues, or quality. Returns the pull request key/ID and source branch for each PR, which can be used with other tools that accept a pullRequest parameter. For long-lived branches (main, develop), use list_branches instead.
